title: Stat mod
description:
A mod for an smp as it is a mod where if you kill someone you may spend that on upgrading your attributes
I am making version 2 rn (menu overhaul mainly visual updates)
body: Press they "-" key to open the upgrade menu, and the "=" menu to open the stat viewer where you can see your attributes. To set up the mod instant respawn is required and a stat where if you kill a player it goes to a leaderboard stat called "kill" Case sensitive. (this is the only version im posting unless you want to dm me on discord, red_clover_pc_og). Made on MCreator.
